q1.answer: You can place an order by browsing our menu, adding items to your cart, and proceeding to checkout. You can choose between delivery or pickup options.
q1.question: How do I place an order?

q2.answer: We accept credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard), digital wallets, and cash on delivery. All online payments are securely processed.
q2.question: What payment methods do you accept?

q3.answer: Delivery typically takes 30-45 minutes depending on your location and order volume. You can track your order in real-time after placing it.
q3.question: How long does delivery take?

q4.answer: You can modify or cancel your order within 5 minutes of placing it. After that, please contact our support team for assistance.
q4.question: Can I modify or cancel my order?

q5.answer: You earn 1 point for every $1 spent. Points can be redeemed for discounts on future orders. Check your loyalty balance in the app.
q5.question: How do loyalty points work?

q6.answer: If you are unsatisfied with your order, please contact us within 24 hours. We offer refunds or replacements for quality issues.
q6.question: What is your refund policy?

q7.answer: Go to Profile → My Addresses to add, edit, or remove delivery addresses. You can also add a new address during checkout.
q7.question: How do I update my delivery address?

q8.answer: Yes! Menu items are labeled with dietary information (vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, etc.). You can also add special instructions when ordering.
q8.question: Do you cater for dietary restrictions?

cookies.content:

• Remember your preferences
• Keep you signed in
• Analyze site traffic and usage
• Personalize your experience

You can manage cookie preferences in your browser settings.
cookies.title: Cookies and Tracking

data_security.content:
We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information, including:

• Encryption of sensitive data
• Secure payment processing
• Regular security assessments
• Access controls for our staff
data_security.title: Data Security

data_sharing.content:
We do not sell your personal information. We may share your information with:

• Delivery partners to fulfill your orders
• Payment processors for secure transactions
• Service providers who assist our operations
• Law enforcement when required by law
data_sharing.title: Information Sharing

how_use.content:
We use the information we collect to:

• Process and deliver your orders
• Send order confirmations and updates
• Provide customer support
• Improve our services and menu offerings
• Send promotional offers (with your consent)
• Ensure security and prevent fraud
how_use.title: How We Use Your Information

info_collect.content:
We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, place an order, or contact us for support.

This includes:
• Name and contact information
• Delivery address
• Payment information
• Order history and preferences
• Communication preferences
info_collect.title: Information We Collect

updates.content: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any significant changes by posting the new policy on our website and updating the "Last updated" date.
updates.title: Policy Updates

your_rights.content:
You have the right to:

• Access your personal data
• Correct inaccurate information
• Request deletion of your data
• Opt out of marketing communications
• Export your data

Contact us to exercise these rights.
your_rights.title: Your Rights

cancellation_refunds.content:
Our cancellation and refund policy:

• Orders can be cancelled within 5 minutes of placing
• Refunds for quality issues will be assessed case by case
• Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days
• We may offer store credit as an alternative

Please contact us immediately if there are issues with your order.
